scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -n engine,shared,server,web -c gray,gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @bustit/engine" "npm run dev -w @bustit/shared" "npm run dev -w @bustit/server" "npm run dev -w @bustit/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.lint: npm run build:libs && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.lint:fix: npm run build:libs && npm run lint:fix --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
